attributes.name: Justice Ironbriar
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, choose a character at your location; that character summons and encounters a random monster.

If there are no other characters at your location, the difficulty to defeat Justice Ironbriar is increased by 1d4.

"Father Skinsaw has revealed to me the truths beneath flesh, and I judge all of Magnimar guilty!"—Justice Ironbriar
